summary: Appends integer a2 to a dynamic array (capacity at this+0x0, element count at this+0x4, data buffer pointer at this+0x8). When count equals capacity, grows capacity by 8: allocates a new 4-byte-per-element buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, copies existing elements, frees the old buffer, and stores the new pointer. Appends the value at data[count], increments the count, and returns the previous count.

operations.description: If element count (this+0x4) equals capacity (this+0x0), grow the array.
Allocate a new buffer of 4 bytes per element for the new capacity via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper.
Copy each of the existing count elements from the old buffer into the new buffer.
If the old buffer pointer (this+0x8) is non-zero, free it.
Free the old array buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Point this+0x8 at the newly allocated buffer.
Write a2 into data[count] (element at offset 4 * count in the buffer).
Increment the element count at this+0x4.
